hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd="$HOOK_TOOL_INPUT_CMD"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git (commit|push)"; then echo "[hook] 提交前检查：运行 cargo clippy + cargo test + npm run typecheck + npm run test"; (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cargo clippy -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -5 && cargo test 2>&1 | tail -10 && npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -5 && npm run test -- --run 2>&1 | tail -10) || { echo "[hook] 检查失败，提交被阻止"; exit 2; }; fi'

bash -c 'file="$HOOK_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE "\.rs$"; then echo "[hook] Rust 文件变更，运行 cargo clippy"; (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cargo clippy -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -20); elif echo "$file" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx)$"; then echo "[hook] TS 文件变更，运行 typecheck"; (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20); fi'
